description: Explain WHY a search returns what it does — the board's own decision trace merged with the run's outcome. Shows the parsed query (terms, exclusions, intent-lifts, alias expansions), which filters were applied vs IGNORED and why, the route and retriever chosen, the ranking regime (ranked/ring-merged/deep-page and the seam), plus the real run's route, timings, count basis and any fallback. Use this when a search returns surprising, empty, or mis-ranked results — it turns 'why?' into one call. Takes the SAME arguments as search_jobs. Needs a key or a sign-in.

agentReadyOnly.description: Only jobs the apply agent can submit to on the user's behalf.

category.description: Comma list of category slugs (see board_stats for the live set), max 3.

companies.description: Scope to specific employers: a comma list of companyToken values from job cards (or from the site's employer pages). An employer the board does not carry simply matches nothing; tokens the board drops are named in ignoredFilters.

department.description: Substring match on the employer's own department/team text.

employmentType.description: Comma list of: full_time, part_time, contract, temporary, internship.

excludeAgencies.description: Hide postings from staffing/recruiting agencies (their job cards carry agency:true). Agencies are served by default; this is an opt-in narrowing.

experience.description: Comma list of seniority bands the POSTING asks for: entry, mid, senior, expert. Rows whose band could not be read are excluded — use maxYears for the candidate's own side of the question.

hasStatedPay.description: Only postings that state a salary (excludes the ~87% that don't).

includeUnstatedPay.description: WIDENS an active salaryMin/salaryMax band to also admit postings that state no pay at all. Inert with no band set (unpriced rows are already included). The response says salaryStatedOnly when a band is narrowing without it.

maxAgeDays.description: Only postings from the last N days (1-30).

maxYears.description: Only roles asking for at most N years of experience.

offset.description: Paging offset — pass back the previous response's nextOffset.

payBasis.description: Restrict to hourly or salaried pay.

postedAfter.description: ISO-8601 instant; only postings the EMPLOYER dated after it. Undated rows fall out of this window (unlike maxAgeDays, which falls back to when the board first saw a posting), so this is the strict form of 'new'.

salaryMin.description: Annual USD-equivalent salary floor. Note: only ~13% of postings state pay.

vendor.description: Comma list of hiring-system vendors (greenhouse, lever, ashby, …), max 8. Not available here: usajobs — The U.S. federal job feed is readable on resumebooster.work but may not be redistributed as a data feed under its terms of use, so no tool here returns its rows. Naming one is refused rather than answered with an empty page.

workMode.description: Comma list of: remote, hybrid, onsite.

name: debug_search

decision.description: The board's own explain trace for this query: parsed terms, filters applied or ignored and why, route, retriever and ranking regime. Its keys are the board's and change as the board's decisions do.

agenciesExcluded.description: Row-selecting: disclosed agency inventory is hidden from this page.

countUnavailable.description: The board could not count this query exactly — do not report a total.

ignoredFilters.description: Filters the board could NOT apply. Results answer a wider question than was asked.

intentFilters.description: Words read out of the query as filters.

nextOffset.description: Pass back as `offset` for the next page.

phaseMs.description: Per-phase timings when the board reports them.

rankedFellBack.description: True when the ranked path failed and the run fell back.

salaryStatedOnly.description: Row-selecting: this page excludes the ~87% of postings with no stated pay.

topTitles.description: The first five titles served, for a glance at ranking.

total.description: Exact match count. ABSENT with countUnavailable:true when the board refuses to guess.

title: Explain a search
